description: Get a flat feed of recent token listings. Defaults remain backward-compatible with the legacy spot listing feed, which holds only resolved spot listings (CoinGecko id + mapped narrative), so the newest tokens and perps are missing and `limit` truncates it without a cursor; pass an event filter or `from` for the complete event feed. Event filters add source-observation freshness, partial status, and provider coverage so agents can reject incomplete opportunity scans.

days.description: How many days back to include. Default 90.

from.description: ISO date or datetime lower bound.

narrative.description: Filter to a single narrative slug.

to.description: ISO date or datetime upper bound.

name: get_recent_listings

last_observed_at.description: Newest timestamp on this provider's rows (write, announce, first-seen, first-trade or effective time), capped at the response time; null when it returned no rows. Database: the newest row write or observation. Official overlay: the newest listing time the venue reports, not our fetch time (a scheduled pre-launch row's first_seen_at is the fetch time).

generated_at.description: Event-feed response assembly time; present when event-specific filters are used.

last_updated_at.description: Freshest source observation; present when event-specific filters are used.

partial.description: True exactly when partial_reasons is non-empty; present when event-specific filters are used.

partial_reasons.description: One sentence per coverage gap: a provider whose request failed, a live exchange instrument feed whose newest listing is more than 60 days old, the hourly spot-listings ingest when the query covers its venues and its last completed run is more than 2 hours old, the canonical events table being unavailable (rows then come from the compatibility table), or a requested exchange, venue_type or market_type that no enabled connector covers. Empty when coverage is whole. Present when event-specific filters are used.

provider_coverage.description: Per-provider health; present when event-specific filters are used.

meta.description: Which route answered, what the API said about the data's freshness, and whether the client cut the answer to fit the agent's context window.

route.description: Always `v1`: every call reads the keyed /v1 route.

truncated.description: True when the answer is cut short: by the API's row budget, or by the client (`truncated_fields`).

truncated_fields.description: The arrays and strings the client cut, by JSON path in `data`: `total` items received, `showing` kept, `kept: latest` when an oldest-first series kept its newest items.

warnings.description: What the API or the client could not do, in words. State them with the answer.

pagination.description: Present when the answer is one page: pass `cursor` back to read the next one.

title: Recent new listings
